name: Computer Science
author: CalcShelf
description: IPv4 and IPv6 subnetting (CIDR, VLSM, summaries), bits and bytes, storage sizes in decimal (kB, MB, GB) and binary (KiB, MiB, GiB) units, data rates and transfer times, number bases and bitwise operations, and tables: CIDR masks, special address ranges, ports, ASCII, powers of 2, integer and floating-point formats, algorithm complexity and HTTP status codes.

variables.name: Link efficiency
variables.description: Fraction of the line rate the data gets after protocol overhead (about 0.94 for TCP over Ethernet).

variables.name: Round-trip time
variables.description: Time for a packet to go and its reply to come back.

variables.name: Bandwidth–delay product
variables.description: Data in flight on a link: the TCP window needed to fill it.

variables.name: Parallel fraction
variables.description: Fraction of the work that can run in parallel (Amdahl).

items.title: IPv4 subnet calculator
items.note: Network, broadcast, mask, wildcard, host range and the bits; split into subnets; VLSM; summarize.
items.tags: cidr netmask wildcard broadcast hosts vlsm supernet summary route

items.title: IPv6 subnet calculator
items.note: Expand and compress, the network and range of a prefix, and smaller prefixes inside it.

items.title: CIDR prefixes and masks
items.note: Usable hosts = addresses − 2 (network and broadcast), except /31 (point-to-point) and /32.

items.title: Storage size
items.note: kB, MB, GB are powers of 1000 (drive makers, networking); KiB, MiB, GiB are powers of 1024 (memory, and the sizes most operating systems show).

items.title: Drive size as the computer shows it
items.note: A drive sold as 2 TB holds 2 × 10¹² bytes; Windows shows that as 1.82 “TB” (really TiB).

items.title: Data rate
items.note: Network speeds are in bits per second (Mbit/s, Gbit/s); download speeds are often shown in bytes per second (MB/s).

items.title: Transfer time
items.note: η is the fraction of the line rate the data gets: about 0.94 for TCP over Ethernet, less over Wi-Fi.

items.title: Number base converter
items.note: Decimal, hexadecimal, binary and octal, any size.

items.title: Bitwise operations
items.note: Whole numbers. NOT is shown for the word size you pick.

items.title: Two’s complement
items.note: A signed value and its bit pattern as an unsigned number, and back.
